messages:
maya: Heads-up from today's onboarding: demo harness didn't pick up rotated keys for a customer. They had REDWOOD_API_KEY in their env but also a legacy RW_TOKEN mounted. Repro in next message.

linh: annoying — can you paste the minimal repro & logs?

maya: repro:
```
# container has RW_TOKEN mounted via secret (old)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=new-from-console
kubectl rollout restart deploy/demo
# app log: "auth: using RW_TOKEN from /etc/creds (expired)"
# requests 401 until we manually delete the pod
```
logs show: "creds-resolver: chose RW_TOKEN (legacy) over REDWOOD_API_KEY"

frank: that matches other reports. We have inconsistent precedence across runtimes + cache invalidation gaps. Some runtimes prefer file > legacy > primary, others prefer primary > legacy > file.

linh: quick check in node sdk shows this resolver: `process.env.RW_TOKEN || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || readFile('/etc/creds')` — totally inverted from docs.

maya: proposed immediate fixes:
1) normalize precedence: prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY (primary) > RW_TOKEN (legacy) > file-backed creds. Emit WARN when legacy alias used.
2) add a cheap startup fingerprint for file creds (sha256 first 512 bytes). If fingerprint != cache, invalidate cache and reload on boot.
3) expose `client.reloadCredentials()` and wire SIGHUP to call it for unix daemons; on Windows provide an explicit API.
4) CLI flag `--force-cred-refresh` for CI jobs.

frank: +1. Also add telemetry fields: `cred.source` (env|legacy|file) and `cred.legacy_alias=true/false` so we can measure how many clients rely on old vars.

linh: parity note: we should factor this into a tiny sharable package `@redwood/creds` (and py equivalent) so node/py/go share the same resolver logic and tests. Keep it tiny and sync versions.

maya: docs: add a short appendix explaining precedence, k8s patterns (Downward API vs secret mounts), and recommended reload strategies. doc-bot, can you file this?

doc-bot: created DOCS-5402 "Credential precedence & rotation: quickstart appendix", assigned to @maria-docs.

maya: test plan: unit tests for precedence matrix, integration simulating secret rewrite + restart, signal reload test, and a small cross-sdk compatibility test that vendors the shared resolver.

frank: implementation owners: linh protos resolver & fingerprint, i'll wire reload into sample-app and CI, maya will own docs + quickstart updates. We'll also add a low-noise startup WARN when conflicting vars are present that explains which was chosen and links to migration guide.

ops-bot: FYI: recommend adding an ops note for k8s: use `kubectl rollout restart` or a controller that restarts pods on secret change; Downward API doesn't auto-update env values.

linh: I'll open a draft PR with changes and a compatibility test matrix. ping me for review if you want to stress-test the fingerprint perf.

maya: thanks all. if we get this in next sprint it should remove a lot of onboarding friction. :thumbsup:
